entry.title: Hello, world
entry.content: This is my personal website. I’m a B.Tech student at IIT Gandhinagar, and this is where I keep track of my work in applied machine learning, computer vision, and LLM systems. I’ll use this blog to write about projects I’ve built, such as the paged KV cache inference engine and the optical flow pipeline for lunar descent, and what I learned while building them. You can find the projects themselves on the projects page.
entry.summary: Why this site exists and what I'll write about.
